issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires that the abstract class Ride be package-private (not declared public), but the solution implementation declares Ride as public. This mismatches the intended visibility and can confuse students about the required visibility modifier and cause tests that check for package-private visibility to fail.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the declaration of Ride package-private to match the problem specification. Concretely, change the class header in Ride.java from 'public abstract class Ride' to 'abstract class Ride'. Ensure tests and any example solution reflect this visibility so students are not confused about the required modifier.
